knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Non-critical kit meets healthy skin alone. Critical kit penetrates sterile tissue, or enters the blood vessels. Semi-critical kit meets mucosa or damaged skin.
The guideline says disposables should not go through reprocessing, and a facility that does so requires a TGA licence and must accept audit. The other choices conflict with that position.
The guideline's logic is that category follows contact site and manufacturer labelling. Appearance reveals neither, so the cleaner relies on the facility list.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads a facility category list and classifies three items shown on cards.
Learner states the referral step for an item whose category is unclear.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Referral record for any unclear item in the simulation
stopWorkCriteria: An item's category is unclear and the learner is asked to clean or reprocess it
A single-use device is found in a reusable stream
An item shows visible contamination and the learner has no authority to reprocess it
